title: Stanley G. Ellis
vital_facts: Baptized as a child; Aaronic Priesthood as a youth; Melchizedek Priesthood as a young adult
Married Kathryn Kloepfer, June 7, 1969, Los Angeles California Temple; eight children
Bachelor's in Governmental Studies, Harvard University, 1972; Juris Doctorate from BYU Law School, 1976
Employment: Financial consultant with First Meridian headquartered in Houston, Texas
Counselor in Elders Quorum Presidency and Bishopric; High Councilor; Stake President; Area Seventy
President of Brazil Sao Paulo North Mission, 1999-2002
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
